name: Vijay’s SMTP Connector for Zoho Mail
author: Ravindra Gehlot

sections.description:
Vijay’s SMTP Connector for Zoho Mail replaces WordPress’s default PHP mail() function with a proper SMTP connection to Zoho Mail, so outgoing mail from your site is authenticated and delivered reliably.

This plugin is an independent, third-party tool built to work with Zoho Mail. It is not developed, endorsed, or affiliated with Zoho Corporation. “Zoho” is a trademark of Zoho Corporation Pvt. Ltd.

Features

  • ⚙️ SMTP setup with SSL/TLS support (ports 465 & 587)
  • 📥 Complete IMAP & POP3 reference (all regions)
  • 🌐 MX record details for domain verification
  • 🛡️ SPF, DKIM & DMARC record reference
  • 🧪 One-click test email with live feedback
  • 🔐 Secure App Password storage
  • 🌍 Regional server guide (US, EU, India, Australia)

SMTP Settings

  • Host: smtp.zoho.com
  • Port: 465 (SSL) or 587 (TLS/STARTTLS)
  • Authentication: Required
  • Username: your full Zoho email address
  • Password: your Zoho App Password

MX Records

Add these to your domain DNS:

  • Priority 10 → mx.zoho.com
  • Priority 20 → mx2.zoho.com
  • Priority 50 → mx3.zoho.com

SPF Record

Add a TXT record: v=spf1 include:zoho.com ~all
sections.installation:
1. Upload the vijays-smtp-connector-for-zoho-mail folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin in Plugins → Installed Plugins
  3. Go to Settings → SMTP Connector for Zoho
  4. Enter your Zoho credentials and save
  5. Use the Test Email tab to verify delivery
sections.faq:
Is this plugin made by Zoho?

No. It is an independent plugin and is not affiliated with Zoho Corporation.

Which password should I use?

Generate an App Password in Zoho Mail (Settings → Security → App Passwords) and use that instead of your login password.
